title: Understanding Model Risk
text: Model risk is the sum of bias squared, variance, and observational variance. When Ishani adds more features, the model risk decreases. This suggests changes in bias and variance.

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: Adding more features to a model typically decreases bias but can increase variance. Consider how this affects the model risk.

title: Calculating New Model Risk
text: The new model risk is $$17$$. Use the formula: Model Risk $$=$$ $${Bias}^2$$ + Variance + Observational Variance to find possible values for bias and variance.

title: Determine New Bias and Variance
text: Given the new model risk is $$17$$, and the observational variance is $$3$$, calculate possible values for bias squared and variance.

title: Possible Values for Bias and Variance
text: Consider combinations of bias squared and variance that sum to $$14$$. Remember, both values must be non-negative.
